saved_candidate.exact_clause: 2.2 The $E_i$ formula. For $E_i$ the finite-prefix coproduct shifts an entry with $i_k\equiv i+1$ to $i_k-1$; if it collides the term is zero, and otherwise it deletes the corner cell $(k,\lambda_k)$ of residue $i$, whose smaller diagram is $\mu-\gamma$. The suffix $K^{-1}$-weight contributes the addable and removable $i$-corners of $\mu-\gamma$ strictly to the left (lower content) of the removed node; the single artificial boundary pair at the cutoff contributes the reciprocal scalar $q^{-\delta_{i\equiv M-N}}$, and appending one more ground entry changes exactly this scalar to its inverse in the same way, so the renormalised operator $q^{-\delta_{i\equiv M-N}}E_i$ is cutoff-independent and defines the stable limit by [F2]. The sign is negative because $E_i$ shifts down in the wedge. [step 1.1, F1, F2, F3, algebra]
